design_notes.authority: monsters.json supplies names, levels, weaknesses, combat behavior and drops. This overlay supplies only category, family, habitats, lore and research thresholds.
design_notes.hunt_habitats: Guild survey field-guide territory, not a spawn guarantee. Hunt registry has no region field.
design_notes.resistances: Not listed because authoritative combat data has no explicit resistance field.
design_notes.migration: Research tiers derive from existing bestiary.defeats at read time. Only permanent mastery receipts add player state; kill history is never copied or reset.
design_notes.reward_policy: One permanent mastery seal and one Research Point are granted per mastered base entry through a durable once-only receipt. No drop bonus is enabled.

goblins.name: Goblins
goblins.description: They love a shiny trinket, a poorly guarded supply pack, and a fight they think they can win.

wolves.name: Wolves & Hounds
wolves.description: Follow the pawprints, watch the tree line, and remember: the lone wolf rarely stays alone.

flora.name: Living Flora
flora.description: The plants out here have teeth, tempers, and absolutely no respect for a gardener.

insects.name: Insects
insects.description: The buzzing usually gives them away. Usually.

flans.name: Flans
flans.description: Not every puddle is water. Some of them would quite like to eat you.

fiends.name: Fiends & Voidborn
fiends.description: When the air turns cold and your torch flickers, these are the things you hope not to meet.

bombs.name: Bombs
bombs.description: Beautiful from a distance. Best admired from a very long distance.

birds.name: Avian Beasts
birds.description: Feathers, talons, and a bird’s-eye view of adventurers who forgot to look up.

undead.name: Undead
undead.description: Some guardians never leave their posts, even long after the rest of them is gone.

cactuars.name: Cactuars
cactuars.description: All needles and nervous energy. Blink, and you might miss them entirely.

constructs.name: Golems & Constructs
constructs.description: Stone or steel, spellwork or machinery—these guardians have outlasted the people who built them.

aquatic.name: Aquatic Beasts
aquatic.description: The shoreline looks peaceful right up until something beneath it spots you.

tonberries.name: Tonberries
tonberries.description: One small lantern in the dark is more than enough reason to turn around.

coeurls.name: Coeurls
coeurls.description: Those whiskers are not decorative. If a Coeurl is watching you, assume it noticed you first.

malboros.name: Malboros
malboros.description: A warning from every veteran: keep your distance, and never trust the breeze.

mimics.name: Mimics & Curios
mimics.description: That promising chest might be full of treasure. It might also have a very big mouth.

wild_beasts.name: Wild Beasts
wild_beasts.description: The wilds belong to them. Travelers are merely passing through—if they’re lucky.

dragons.name: Dragons & Drakes
dragons.description: From hot-blooded drakes to ancient wyrms, every one of them deserves a little respect.

worms.name: Worms
worms.description: The ground can be just as dangerous as the creatures walking on it.

chimeras.name: Chimeras
chimeras.description: Several dangerous ideas in one creature, and not one of them is friendly.

behemoths.name: Behemoths
behemoths.description: If the ground begins to shake, find something sturdier than your shield.

adamantoises.name: Adamantoises
adamantoises.description: Their shells have weathered more battles than most Guild veterans will ever see.

watchers.name: Floating Watchers
watchers.description: One enormous eye is all they need to make an adventurer feel thoroughly unwelcome.

magitek.name: Magitek & Omega
magitek.description: The old machines are still following their orders. Nobody thought to tell them the war was over.

elementals.name: Elementals
elementals.description: The land’s own magic, given shape and a rather unpredictable mood.

spellcasters.name: Sorcerers & Wanderers
spellcasters.description: Some meet travelers with a greeting. These prefer a spell at twenty paces.

giants.name: Giants
giants.description: When something this big is angry, there is no such thing as a safe hiding place.

goblin.lore: A nimble scavenger drawn to the old roads, where abandoned packs often become its next prize.

wolf.lore: Greenwind packs hunt along the grassline and retreat to cover when the wind turns.

mandragora.lore: Its roots twitch at approaching footsteps; careless travelers learn why botanists wear ear protection.

goblin_chieftain.lore: The chieftain rules its scavenger band from a makeshift throne of stolen expedition supplies.

goblin_guard.lore: Guards fashion uneven armor from discarded metal and rarely stray far from their chieftain.

hornet.lore: The plains' oversized hornets defend their territory with a ferocity out of proportion to their size.

flan.lore: This wandering mass collects moisture and mana from whichever cave or meadow it inhabits.

imp.lore: Mischievous cave-haunters mimic voices to lure travelers away from the marked trails.

dire_wolf_alpha.lore: A scarred pack leader has been sighted following caravans beyond the usual hunting grounds.

bomb.lore: An unstable flame-spirit whose heat rises dangerously when threatened or crowded.

cockatrice.lore: Its shrill calls echo across the plains just before a blur of feathers descends.

bat.lore: Cave bats roost in the highest cracks, emerging when torchlight disturbs their rest.

queen_hornet.lore: The colony's queen nests beyond reach of ordinary hunters and rallies swarms around her.

ochu.lore: A carnivorous plant that blends into dense undergrowth until an unfortunate traveler approaches.

skeleton.lore: Old bones remain animated in the caverns long after their original owners are forgotten.

cactuar.lore: A nervous desert wanderer as famous for sudden sprints as for its needle-covered hide.

ossuary_knight.lore: An armored guardian keeps watch over forgotten tombs beneath the caverns.

spriggan.lore: Small woodland tricksters hide useful trinkets in places no traveler would think to look.

basilisk.lore: A low-slung cave predator whose patient stillness makes its approach difficult to notice.

crimson_detonator.lore: This unusually volatile Bomb has left scorch marks along several abandoned passageways.

gigas.lore: A towering cave-dweller that turns natural stone corridors into cramped hunting grounds.

lamia.lore: A solitary enchantress whose melodies mingle with the Whispering Caverns' natural echoes.

mimic.lore: What appears to be an unattended chest may be the cavern's most patient ambush predator.

gargoyle.lore: Weathered stone wings disguise a watchful creature among collapsed cavern pillars.

sahagin.lore: Coastal raiders favor tidal caves and strike while surf masks their movements.

sahagin_prince.lore: A self-styled prince commands raiding parties from a fortress of salt-worn stone.

tonberry.lore: A lantern-light in a dark passage can be a warning rather than an invitation.

killer_fish.lore: Schools of these aggressive fish stalk shallows where adventurers gather supplies.

cactuar_jack.lore: A conspicuously fast Cactuar has evaded repeated Guild pursuit along the coast.

gigantoad.lore: This oversized amphibian waits beneath riverbank reeds for passing prey.

mindflayer.lore: Travelers whisper of a cavern sorcerer that listens to thoughts more closely than voices.

zu.lore: The giant coastal bird surveys the cliffs before diving on anything that disturbs its nest.

antlion.lore: Sand collapses without warning above the hidden tunnels of this burrowing hunter.

piscodemon.lore: A deep-cavern fiend emerges wherever the rock gives way to ancient underground water.

black_flan.lore: Dark minerals have altered this Flan's coloring and made it nearly invisible in shadow.

coeurl.lore: Its long whiskers register the slightest movement across coastal scrubland.

sand_worm.lore: This burrower crosses long stretches of sand without ever breaking the surface.

chimera.lore: Travelers disagree on which head notices danger first; all agree not to approach.

remora.lore: A reef-side parasite large enough to threaten anything that mistakes it for a harmless fish.

king_coeurl.lore: The coastal Coeurls yield territory to one enormous hunter with a distinctive mane.

magic_pot.lore: A peculiar enchanted vessel that appears in places long abandoned by their former owners.

malboro.lore: The coast's foulest undergrowth conceals a creature that announces itself by smell alone.

sea_serpent.lore: The serpent follows deep coastal channels, surfacing only when its territory is disturbed.

riven_ronin.lore: A lone swordsman is rumored to haunt ruined roads, challenging those who cross his path.

adamantoise.lore: Its ancient shell resembles a small boulder until the creature decides to move.

magitek_drone.lore: A discarded reconnaissance machine still patrols the wastes under obsolete orders.

ahriman.lore: A single unblinking eye surveys the ruins from above, following movement between broken towers.

garuda.lore: A fierce windborne predator that nests wherever coastal cliffs rise into storm clouds.

malboro_overlord.lore: This enormous Malboro has claimed a reeking stretch of marshland for itself.

death_claw.lore: A feral hunter adapted to the wastes, identifiable by the deep furrows it leaves in stone.

iron_giant.lore: An ancient armored sentinel marches the same route long after its purpose has vanished.

iron_giant_exile.lore: Driven from its old patrol, this giant wanders the outer ruins in search of a new charge.

ironclad.lore: A heavily plated war construct built to outlast the machines that once commanded it.

behemoth.lore: A towering beast whose footprints are often the first sign of its arrival.

chimera_brain.lore: This unusual Chimera appears unnervingly alert to the feints of experienced adventurers.

evil_eye.lore: It drifts through abandoned machinery as though inspecting work that will never resume.

malboro_great.lore: Larger and older than its coastal kin, this Malboro thrives among the wastes' fumes.

three_moon_chimera.lore: Guild hunters have tracked this Chimera by three distinct cries heard after dusk.

death_machine.lore: A silent war engine that awakens whenever it detects movement among the ruins.

magitek_armor.lore: Discarded military plating conceals machinery that still answers a forgotten command.

crystal_wolf.lore: Crystal dust glitters along this wolf's coat as it stalks the Expanse's narrow passes.

mover.lore: A curious machine-like elemental that drifts in precise patterns through ruined installations.

tonberry_executioner.lore: A patient figure follows old execution roads with a lantern and an unmistakable blade.

tonberry_king.lore: The bearer of a battered crown receives a wide berth even from other Tonberries.

crystal_golem.lore: A living shard of the Expanse's geology that awakens when its crystal seam is disturbed.

red_dragon.lore: A flame-colored dragon favors the warmest cliffs above the crystal valleys.

blue_dragon.lore: Its blue scales catch the cold light where the Expanse's stone rises into cloud.

elemental_archon.lore: An ancient spirit is said to appear where several crystal currents converge.

magitek_juggernaut.lore: The wastes' largest surviving battle machine appears to have forgotten the concept of retreat.

gold_dragon.lore: Rare sightings speak of scales that gleam like sunlight on polished crystal.

ancient_mimic.lore: A chest older than the nearby ruins is rarely an ordinary piece of furniture.

holy_dragon.lore: Pilgrims once left offerings near the high ridges where this pale dragon circles.

skull_dragon.lore: A long-dead dragon's bones still stir beneath the Expanse's cold crystal winds.

wyrm.lore: An old mountain drake that coils among the Expanse's deep mineral seams.

storm_dragon.lore: Thunder precedes this dragon when it moves between the Expanse's tallest peaks.

behemoth_tyrant.lore: Riftland travelers mark the tyrant's territory with warnings on broken stone.

rift_hound.lore: A lean hunter whose tracks vanish abruptly near unstable rift crossings.

brachosaur.lore: One of the Expanse's oldest herbivores, formidable despite its unhurried gait.

catoblepas.lore: Its heavy head and patient stride belie how quickly it can defend its territory.

void_mage.lore: A robed wanderer gathers forbidden fragments in the Riftlands' ruined sanctuaries.

death_rider.lore: This rider follows roads that no longer exist, never slowing for the living.

ancient_adamantoise.lore: The oldest shell in the Riftlands bears scars mistaken for natural fault lines.

rift_behemoth.lore: This Behemoth has learned to cross broken terrain that stops ordinary creatures.

adamant_golem.lore: Its dense body is almost indistinguishable from the Riftlands' weathered monoliths.

master_tonberry.lore: Veteran travelers recognize the quiet approach of a master long before seeing its lantern.

abaddon.lore: An old fiend stirs where the Riftlands' fractured crystal exposes the world below.

rift_dragon.lore: This dragon claims the broken sky above the Riftlands as its hunting territory.

rift_drake.lore: Smaller than the great Rift dragons, this drake slips through unstable crossings with ease.

land_worm.lore: The earth trembles softly before the worm emerges from loose Riftland soil.

great_wyrm.lore: This immense drake coils through rock corridors too narrow for most other dragons.

void_tonberry.lore: The strange light of its lantern appears only where the Rift thins the world.

astral_construct.lore: A geometric guardian remains active around ruins older than the surviving maps.

crystal_dragon.lore: Its scales resonate faintly with the crystal formations of the Interdimensional Rift.

archeodemon.lore: Ancient seals mark the places where this fiend is said to have been imprisoned.

omega_fragment.lore: A broken part of an unknown machine continues to execute fragments of its last directive.

varuna.lore: An elusive rift-dweller appears where magical currents have become dangerously unstable.

void_avatar.lore: An embodiment of the Rift's deeper shadows takes shape around concentrated crystal energy.

demonolith.lore: Inscribed stone faces conceal a creature that has watched generations of travelers pass.

floating_death.lore: An enormous hovering eye studies intruders from the ruins' highest chambers.

machea.lore: A strange fiend patrols the shattered approaches to Omega's forgotten domain.

master_coeurl.lore: The largest Coeurl tracks in the Omega Ruins belong to a remarkably elusive hunter.

dark_element.lore: A dense knot of shadow drifts wherever the ruins' crystal light fails.

malboro_menace.lore: This malignant growth survives where the Omega Ruins' air is barely breathable.

spirit.lore: Old echoes gather into visible shapes among corridors sealed for centuries.

great_malboro_omega.lore: An ancient Malboro has thrived in Omega's poisoned air beyond all expectation.

mimic_king.lore: The king of false treasure conceals itself amid hoards left by countless expeditions.

omega_sentinel.lore: A dormant guardian awakens when explorers stray near Omega's inner chambers.

elder_ochu.lore: Locals say the Emerald Wilds used to have a path through this grove. The Elder Ochu has spent years making sure nobody finds it again.

inferno_drake.lore: The Inferno Drake nests where the Ashen Highlands burn hottest. Its shadow over the mountain is usually the last warning travelers get.

malboro_sovereign.lore: Even the smaller Malboros keep their distance from this marshland giant. If the mist begins to smell sweet, turn back.

frost_behemoth.lore: There are tracks in Frostveil Reach wide enough to swallow a campfire. The Frost Behemoth leaves very few others.

rift_wyrm.lore: The Rift Wyrm moves through the Astral Scar as easily as other dragons cross a mountain pass. It has no intention of sharing the route.

tempest_roc.lore: This legendary sky predator guards the highest shattered isles against anyone who approaches its stormbound nest.

aetherstorm_colossus.lore: Charged by endless crystal storms, this towering airborne construct drives travelers away from the heart of the Expanse.

dominion_sentinel.lore: The last guardian of the Forgotten Dominion watches an empty imperial throne and obeys orders from a vanished era.
